name: night-flash-y2k-blonde-babe
image_purpose: hair, outfit, flash, and waterfront nightlife reference

prompt.project_info: Create a direct-flash waterfront nightlife portrait of an approved adult woman.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult woman with long sleek platinum-blonde hair, soft glam makeup, white opaque fitted short-sleeve top, blue denim jeans, white manicure, and a relaxed peace-sign gesture near her cheek.
prompt.composition_elements: Waist-up or three-quarter portrait, slightly angled stance, dark waterfront boardwalk or beachside background, distant city lights, direct eye contact, confident but non-flirtatious expression.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Hard on-camera flash with bright subject and deep blue-black background, small distant lights, subtle film grain, energetic night-out mood.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic high-end smartphone/compact-camera image, portrait 4:5, 28mm wide-angle, sharp subject, rapid background falloff, natural skin texture.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Approved adult woman with long sleek platinum-blonde hair takes a direct-flash waterfront night portrait wearing an opaque white short-sleeve top and blue jeans, making a relaxed peace sign near her cheek. Use dark blue-black sky, distant city lights, sharp realistic skin, Y2K flash aesthetic, and subtle film grain. No exposed midriff or watermark.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, underage, childlike, crop top, exposed midriff, lingerie, transparent clothing, sexualized pose, distorted hands, plastic skin, daylight, warm studio light, watermark, logo invention, public figure likeness.
